name: bug
description: Something isn't working

name: enhancement
description: New feature or request

name: documentation
description: Improvements or additions to documentation

name: chore
description: CI, tooling, process or release work; no change to what the package does

name: area:evolve
description: The evolve loop: evolution, async_evolve, aggregator, population, policies, strategies

name: area:meta
description: Meta-evolution stack: meta*, meta_population, portfolio, consolidation, curriculum

name: area:runstore
description: Run store, ledger, checkpoint, resume and replay

name: area:audit
description: agentdescent/audit, meta_audit, chain_audit, verifier and oracle calibration

name: area:agents
description: Model adapters and providers (agents.py, backends, API keys via env)

name: area:plugins
description: Host plugins and installers: Claude Code, Codex, DSH, OpenCode, MCP server

name: area:cli
description: The agentdescent command line (cli.py, doctor, plan/evolve/status/apply)

name: area:ports
description: Faithful algorithm ports: examples/<algorithm>/ and agentdescent/algorithms

name: area:bench
description: Benchmarks, A/B runs and reports (bench/, reports/)

name: area:docs
description: Documentation site (docs/, mkdocs.yml) and README

name: area:ci
description: CI workflows, release, packaging and the repo process (.github/, AGENTS.md)

name: self-test
description: Filed by the product self-test routine (issues only)

name: needs-info
description: Waiting for the reporter or a maintainer decision

name: needs-human
description: The agent loop stopped; a person must decide (reason in the last comment)

name: agent-ready
description: Triaged spec: an agent may take it. Set by a maintainer or the maintenance routine only

name: agent-working
description: An agent has claimed this issue (the claim comment names the branch)

name: agent-pr
description: Pull request opened by an agent

name: awaiting-approval
description: Green T2/T3 PR: waits for a PASS at its tip and Danyang's merge click

name: hold
description: A person froze this issue or PR; agents and automation leave it alone

name: risk:T0
description: Risk tier T0 (docs only), set by the controller from the diff; never by hand

name: risk:T1
description: Risk tier T1 (tests, examples, changelog.d), set by the controller from the diff

name: risk:T2
description: Risk tier T2 (package code or an unnamed path), set by the controller from the diff

name: risk:T3
description: Risk tier T3 (core loop, release, process; needs Danyang's click), set by the controller
